<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| principles | Replace every rsplit_once('·') reading of the Codex footer with one parser that returns the footer's parts (model, effort, cwd) or None. Recognition, readiness, model and cwd all consume it (one definition, as the existing doc comment demands). Extra segments after the cwd are ignored, never parsed as data. Tests use recorded fixtures, bottom lines only. |
| composition_root | crates/harnesses/src/composer.rs |
| contracts | codex footer parser: line -&gt; Option&lt;CodexFooter{model, effort, cwd}&gt;; is_codex_footer = parser(line).is_some() |
| seams | crates/harnesses/src/composer.rs:75 and :201, crates/harnesses/src/adapter.rs:278, ~350, ~370, crates/daemon/src/pointer/worker.rs ~374 (unrecognized retry; read only) |
